name: jumping-fitness-rules-tests
description: Тесты Firestore Security Rules и Cloud Functions на локальных эмуляторах

scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix ../../functions run build && node ../../functions/scripts/firebase-emulators.mjs emulators:exec --config ../../firebase.test.json --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-jumping-fitness "node --test --test-concurrency=1 functions.test.mjs business.test.mjs flowers.test.mjs notifications.test.mjs"
scripts.test:yandex: npm --prefix ../../functions run build && node ../../functions/scripts/firebase-emulators.mjs emulators:exec --config ../../firebase.test.json --only auth,firestore --project demo-jumping-fitness "node run-adapter.mjs yandex http-api.test.mjs yandex.test.mjs functions.test.mjs business.test.mjs flowers.test.mjs notifications.test.mjs"
scripts.test:netlify: npm --prefix ../../functions run build && node ../../functions/scripts/firebase-emulators.mjs emulators:exec --config ../../firebase.test.json --only auth,firestore --project demo-jumping-fitness "node run-adapter.mjs netlify http-api.test.mjs netlify.test.mjs functions.test.mjs business.test.mjs flowers.test.mjs notifications.test.mjs"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:functions && npm run test:yandex && npm run test:netlify
